line: Take on a chore for someone who's overwhelmed.
paragraph: A man in Oregon recently turned 108. Three large blue balloons shaped the number above him. A cake sat nearby. He told the people gathered that no one knows what it is to be 100-plus until they get there. He has found out, and he likes it.

seed.summary: A man who’s believed to be the oldest individual in the state of Oregon recently rung in 108-years-young with a cake and some words of wisdom. “You don’t know what it’s like to be 100-plus.
